correction.corrected_diagnosis: researcher interruption while the first target-state clean replay was executing
correction.cause_of_error: A CLOSE-WAIT API socket was mistaken for the active operation. The lifecycle status did not expose the in-flight tool, and the trajectory was not re-read after the last provider response before termination.
correction.operator_action: The runner process group and its construction container were terminated after the incorrect diagnosis. The orphaned replay container was identified from its mounted minimal-b-replay-0001 worktree and removed after forensic inspection.

forensic_evidence.interpretation: The replay tool had accepted a complete program and was still running. Absence of a replay JSONL record reflects interruption before tool completion, not absence of candidate formation.

replacement_rationale: The replacement case, arm, model, provider, seed, image, prompt, evaluator, limits, and run ID were written before the replacement model session began.
No algorithm, prompt, configuration, package rule, or case selection changed between the interrupted episode and replacement.
No program, package cache, trajectory, replay evidence, or evaluator result crossed into the replacement; only the immutable exact-revision source cache was reused.
Because the original interruption was operator-caused rather than external infrastructure, every reported aggregate must also include a sensitivity analysis that excludes the entire cellrank pair.

required_reporting.primary_fixed_replacement_analysis: Use the completed replacement as the preregistered arm outcome and report the operator interruption separately.
required_reporting.sensitivity_analysis: Exclude both cellrank arms and report the remaining three complete pairs.
forbidden_claims: that the original episode failed because of provider infrastructure
that the original episode exhausted requests or failed before candidate formation
that the four-pair batch is a clean held-out or confirmatory effect estimate
